Part 1 The game, step by step

Every picture below is a real frame from the running game, captured in a headless browser.

1 Open the page

First visit shows a short "How to play". After that the home screen runs a live bot match behind the menu, kept cheap on purpose (low frame rate, paused when the window loses focus). Story mode, solo, local, the daily challenge, replays, Quick play and the graphics toggle are all one tap away. Browser Back closes the top layer instead of leaving the site.

2 Pick a look

The same simulation drives four renderers. Classic is pixel art on a 2D canvas. 3D uses Three.js with shadows and bloom. DLSS 6 is a parody: over-sharpened, over-saturated, glossy "Neural Faces", mirrored reflections on desktop, a fake frame-generation counter and a real dynamic resolution. Bomber Shooter is a first-person raycaster over the same match. Parody. Not affiliated with NVIDIA. Bomber Shooter is a nod to the boomer shooter genre, not affiliated with id Software.

First person: left and right turn 90 degrees, up and down walk, , and . strafe, M toggles the minimap. The sim input is still axis-aligned, so it works in solo, local, story and online.

DLSS 6 comes with a fake control panel (G or the RTX settings button) that gives you Frame Generation x4 (x1 actually), Path Tracing (one path), Latency Reduction (-0 ms) and a very serious Bloom slider. Gags are spaced out and nothing changes gameplay.

3 Arenas, themes and floor tiles

Five layouts and five themes, chosen per match or at random per round. Themes are purely visual and work in every renderer. Optionally, floor tiles add ice (you keep sliding), conveyor belts (they push you, bombs and items), teleporter pairs and spikes with a warning phase.

4 Power-ups, special bombs and abilities

Bricks hide eight kinds of items. With Special bombs on, five more appear: glove, punch, cluster, mine and frost. With Abilities on, a second button gives every colour a move with a cooldown ring in the dock. The first board shows the base items, the second a scene with the new items, a frozen player and the ability dock.

  • Bomb +1 bomb at once
  • Range longer blasts
  • Speed run faster
  • Kick walk into a bomb to slide it
  • Remote press bomb again to detonate
  • Pass walk through bombs
  • Shield 5 seconds of flame immunity
  • Skull random curse: slow, fast, reversed, no bombs, auto bombs
  • Glove bomb key on a bomb throws it 3 tiles
  • Punch bomb key facing a bomb knocks it 2 tiles
  • Cluster bursts into mini blasts
  • Mine nearly invisible, triggers when you step next to it
  • Frost freezes for 2 s instead of killing
  • Abilities Dash, Blink, Aegis, Vanish, Crack, Overload, Switcheroo, Sweep, Rise

5 Modes and chaos

Beyond classic last-one-standing: King of the Hill (hold the 3x3 zone, it moves), Hot Potato (touch someone to pass the fuse) and Survival (waves of enemies with red rings). Chaos events add bomb rain, item rain, quake, swap and frenzy, always telegraphed 1.5 s ahead.

6 Sound

All sound is synthesised live with WebAudio: no audio files at all. Music styles are Auto (follows theme and mode), Arcade, Epic, Chill, Synthwave and Silence, which is the default. There is an optional voice announcer, a mute button during play and the N key.

7 Replays and the daily challenge

Every finished match is saved on the device (last 10). A replay is only the recorded inputs, so you can watch it again in any look, pause, seek and change the speed, and share it as a link or a .kaboom file that replays the exact match anywhere. The daily challenge is one seeded rule set per day (UTC), the same for everybody, with a best score, a streak and a shareable score card.

8 Play online

The host creates a room and shares a link or QR code, or taps Quick play to join a public room. A room can be made public from its lobby and can allow spectators, who watch a full room or a running match. Press 1 to 8 for emotes. Names are sanitised, the host decides on rematches, and a guest who drops reconnects within 30 seconds while a bot keeps the slot warm. The server is a small relay that enforces roles, message types, rates and connection limits.

9 On a phone

Virtual joystick, bomb button and an ability button on touch screens, optional vibration and gamepad rumble, an install button, a colour-blind palette, reduce motion, an Offline setting that saves the whole game, and a lighter 3D path (lower resolution, fewer lights) for weaker GPUs.

Part 2 Story mode

Written in the spirit of arcade fighting games: ancient grudges, family ties and a final boss who is somebody's grandfather.

Twenty years ago Baron von Boom stole the Eternal Fuse, the artifact that powers every bomb. Tonight's tournament decides who gets it back. Also, grandpa is up and about.

Play it alone or as two-player co-op on one screen: your hero and the sidekick Sparky face a foe (and later the foe's partner). Before some fights you meet a choice (a street vendor, a bribe, a riddle...) that changes only the next fight, and the way you play decides which of three secret endings you earn. The Story log lists every ending, "???" until found.

Fights 1 and 2 are 2 vs 1, fights 3 to 7 are 2 vs 2 with a bot partner, and the boss is 2 vs 1.

The Fuse dynasty

Ignatius

One-Eyed Ex-Champ · 58

One eye, zero patience. Former champion of Kaboom Arena. Father of Dynamita, brother of Baron, and still owed one Eternal Fuse.

Home stage: Old Man's Backyard pillars / grass

Dynamita

The Hothead · 22

Twenty-two and already on fire. Raised by Ignatius, trained by her godfather the Baron. Mad at both of them, for different reasons.

Home stage: Fireworks Factory cross / lava

Baron

The Betrayer · 60s

Aristocrat, villain and brother who stole the Eternal Fuse 20 years ago. Fights in a monocle. Has never once said sorry.

Home stage: Von Boom Hedge Maze maze / night

Mama

Rolling Pin Queen · 74

Tiny, fierce, 74. Fights with a rolling pin and a grudge. Always said the Baron was a bad influence. Nobody listened.

Home stage: Mama's Kitchen open / snow

Dolores

Bombshell · 45

Glamorous, deadly, between marriages. Ignatius's ex, Dynamita's mother and the Baron's business partner. It is complicated.

Home stage: Bombshell Casino cross / desert

Tony

Tick-Tock · 30

The Baron's chauffeur and enforcer. Green tracksuit, eleven watches, still late for everything.

Home stage: Tick-Tock Parking Lot classic / night

Fizzle

Knight, Sort Of · 35

Knight in a bucket helmet. Fired by the Baron, dumped by Dynamita, fizzled by life. Dreams of revenge. Trips a lot.

Home stage: Draughty Castle pillars / snow

Kapow

Autograph Hunter · 12

Twelve years old. Skateboards in a helmet three sizes too big. Wants everyone's autograph and fights anyway, politely.

Home stage: Skate Park open / desert

Gunpowder

Ancient Patriarch · dead

Dead, buried and furious about it. The patriarch of the Fuse dynasty, back from the Fuse's backlash with a flaming skull and a beard of smoke.

Home stage: The Family Crypt maze / lava

Pre-fight banter

Ignatius vsBaron

Twenty years, Baron. Twenty years since you stole my Fuse and my sock drawer.

Brother, brother. You always did hold a grudge. And a Fuse. Mostly the Fuse.

Dynamita vsBaron

You taught me everything, Godfather! Starting with how to light a fuse. Watch this.

I taught you, child, so you'd be a worthy opponent for my retirement.

Mama vsBaron

Baron Boom, you come here. I did not raise a thief. I raised a tall, ungrateful baby.

Mother, please. I am sixty-something. And is that the rolling pin?

Dynamita vsFizzle

Fizzle? You still wear that bucket? We broke up two years ago!

It's a helmet! And you said 'let's stay friends' by throwing a bomb at me.

Ignatius vsDolores

Dolores. Of all the arenas in all the world, you walk into mine. With him.

Ignatius. You still owe me for the divorce lawyer. And the sofa.

Tony vsKapow

Sibling rivalry, Kapow. Let's take it outside. Into a bomb.

Sibling rivalry, Tony. Let's take it outside. Into a bomb.

Endings

Ignatius's ending
  1. The Baron is beaten. The Eternal Fuse is finally back in the family.
  2. Ignatius lights a victory cigar. Dynamita takes it away. 'You are 58, Dad.'
  3. Dolores arrives with the divorce papers. Again. For old times' sake.
  4. Mama pinches his cheek: 'I always liked you better than Baron.' She says that to both of them.
  5. The old man smiles with his one good eye. Next year's tournament starts Monday.
Dynamita's ending
  1. Dynamita holds the Eternal Fuse over her head. The crowd goes wild. So does the fuse.
  2. Dad says he is proud. Then he asks her to put it down. Then he asks again, louder.
  3. Fizzle sends a bouquet. It explodes. Everyone agrees it was romantic.
  4. Her godfather the Baron is sentenced to a lifetime of Sunday dinners at Mama's.
  5. Dynamita is already designing a bigger bomb. The fuse is lit. It is always lit.
Baron's ending
  1. The Eternal Fuse glows in the Baron's hands. The family is stunned. He is not.
  2. 'Betrayal is such a strong word,' he says. 'I prefer early retirement planning.'
  3. Ignatius tries to speak. The Baron has Tony turn up the radio.
  4. Mama sends a strongly worded casserole. It arrives at 90 miles an hour.
  5. The Baron buys the arena, renames it Von Boom Arena, and sends the bill to his brother.
Mama's ending
  1. Mama Kaboom raises her rolling pin. The arena rises to its feet.
  2. 'I told you the Baron was a bad influence.' Twenty years of 'I told you so' pay out at once.
  3. The Eternal Fuse goes home and into the cupboard, behind the good plates.
  4. Ignatius and Baron are grounded. They are 58 and 60-something. They accept this.
  5. Mama's last words to the crowd: 'Did everybody eat? Good. Now go home.'
Dolores's ending
  1. Dolores walks off with the prize money, the Eternal Fuse and the best photo of the night.
  2. She ends her partnership with the Baron. He asks about the shared yacht. She sinks it.
  3. Ignatius sends flowers. Dynamita sends a thank-you note. Mama sends a rolling pin.
  4. Tony and Kapow open a restaurant with her winnings. It is called Auntie's. It is very loud.
  5. Dolores lights a cigarette with the Eternal Fuse. The fire marshal has questions.
Tony's ending
  1. Tony wins the tournament. He wipes a tear off his watch.
  2. The Baron fires him over the phone. Tony is thrilled: his first day off since 2009.
  3. Kapow gets Tony's autograph, then asks for a second one, then a hat.
  4. Aunt Dolores wants a cut. Cousin Dynamita wants a rematch. Tony wants a nap.
  5. He is on time for the ceremony at last. Nobody else is. Typical.
Fizzle's ending
  1. Sir Fizzle takes off his bucket helmet. The crowd gasps. He has a really nice face.
  2. The Baron begs for mercy. 'You fizzled me first,' says Fizzle, and nobody gets the joke.
  3. Dynamita texts her congratulations. He reads it nine times and walks into a door.
  4. He carries the Eternal Fuse home on his horse. The horse is not impressed.
  5. Knight, champion and, for one night, a man who did not fizzle.
Kapow's ending
  1. Kid Kapow wins the tournament and skates three victory laps around the arena.
  2. He gets autographs from the whole family. Even Grandpa. Especially Grandpa.
  3. Tony cries into his watches. Aunt Dolores buys him a helmet that fits.
  4. Cousin Dynamita says 'You're a legend.' Kapow says 'Cool, can you sign this?'
  5. The Eternal Fuse is now a skateboard trophy. It is very hard to grind.
Gunpowder's ending
  1. The patriarch of the Fuse dynasty rises, flaming skull held high. The family faints.
  2. 'Who ate my dessert?' he asks. Twenty years dead and he still remembers.
  3. Baron confesses everything. Ignatius cries. Mama hits them both with the rolling pin.
  4. The Eternal Fuse is back where it belongs: in a very old, very smoky beard.
  5. Gunpowder returns to his grave, satisfied. The tombstone says 'BRB'.

Part 3 Under the hood

Host browserruns the 60 Hz simulation and the bots
snapshots 30 Hz →
← inputs
Rails relayroles, allow-lists, rate and connection limits
→ snapshots
inputs ←
Guest browserspredict their own player, interpolate the rest ~100 ms behind
  • Replays are free. A replay is the recorded inputs plus a seed, so links and .kaboom files need no server and play back in any renderer.
  • Procedural sound. Effects and four music styles are synthesised in the browser, with no audio files.
  • One simulation. sim.js is pure and deterministic. Solo, local, host and guest prediction all run the same code, covered by 258 tests including a host plus guest harness with simulated latency, jitter and packet loss.
  • Bots that think ahead. Danger is a time map that includes chain reactions; they flee on a clock, take bonuses, avoid sudden death, and come in three levels.
  • Frugal by design. No build step, a service worker that is network-first with an offline fallback, a home-screen demo throttled to a few frames per second, and no work at all while paused.
  • Hardened relay. First subscriber owns the room, message types are allow-listed per role, traffic is rate-limited, and every refusal is logged in a format the host monitors.
  • Original art. Sprites and portraits are drawn in code or generated and converted to pixel art; no third-party game assets. A fan-made tribute, not affiliated with Konami. The DLSS 6 mode is a parody, not affiliated with NVIDIA; Bomber Shooter is a nod to the boomer shooter genre, not affiliated with id Software.
